% Shared normative core: requirements, predictions, and authored options
\section{Normative requirements}
\label{sec:requirements}

\begin{longtable}{p{0.25\linewidth}p{0.65\linewidth}}
\toprule
Requirement & Normative statement \\
\midrule
\endhead
\Req{001} & The method identity shall be \ContractID{}, titled ``Optimal
matched-template map filtering,'' subject to the exact qualification in
Section~\ref{sec:optimality}. \\
\Req{002} & The sole signal estimand shall be the fixed-template amplitude at
each admitted anchor; the public signal role is a filtered amplitude map. \\
\Req{003} & Each application shall bind exactly one immutable normalized
ordinary-MAP observation parent or one immutable normalized ordinary-MAP coadd
parent. JINC and other derived parents are excluded. \\
\Req{004} & Observation and coadd applications shall remain distinct; no
commutation, equivalence, state sharing, or FLT-owned coaddition is asserted. \\
\Req{005} & Each application shall bind one immutable template-response
scientific object per unit amplitude. Exact materialized, structured, and
lineage/query representations are admissible only when scientifically
equivalent. \\
\Req{006} & The template shall not be learned or updated from a target,
source, candidate, population, or NOI realization member. \\
\Req{007} & A realization shall bind collision-free $p/q/s/W_p$ notation,
coordinate-basis algebra, domain, real codomains, WCS/frame, indexing, units,
support families, boundaries, estimable subspace, rank/null, regularization,
validity, and any complex-transform adjoint convention. \\
\Req{008} & The authoritative estimator shall be exactly
$n_p=t_p^{\mathsf T}W_pm_p$, $d_p=t_p^{\mathsf T}W_pt_p$, and
$\widehat a_p=n_p/d_p$, with every scientific measure factor inside $W_p$. \\
\Req{009} & Every admitted $W_p$ shall be exactly self-adjoint and positive
semidefinite and every admitted $d_p$ finite, exactly real, and strictly
positive. Numerical tolerances do not alter these scientific predicates. \\
\Req{010} & Complete $\Supp_{\rm apply}(p)$ shall be required. Partial support,
renormalization, extension, imputation, background subtraction, learned taper,
and signal-derived support are excluded. \\
\Req{011} & Fixed-state, full-procedure, realized, and reference response shall
remain separately typed. Required response queries shall be exactly available
or reconstructable; a reduced kernel requires proved invariances and measure. \\
\Req{012} & ``Optimal'' and $d_p^{-1}$ variance require the constrained local
inverse-covariance GLS theorem: restriction before inversion, a positive-
definite estimable covariance, identifiable projected template, identical
constraints/support/state, and the exact competitor class. \\
\Req{013} & Every realization shall identify one owner-selected \AO{001}
weighting alternative separately for its parent class. No option in this draft
is a default. \\
\Req{014} & A parent coefficient shall retain only its declared route-specific
role; its name, sign, units, reciprocal, or diagonal form does not imply
covariance, precision, inverse variance, or independence. \\
\Req{015} & State shall follow Learn--Resolve--Apply. Requested, effective,
candidate, resolved, applied, realized, and published generations remain
distinct; Apply uses immutable state and performs no target/member update. \\
\Req{016} & Observation and coadd state generations shall remain separate and
shall not be substituted for one another. \\
\Req{017} & Every compatible NOI member shall receive the identical resolved
state, transformation, application support, normalization, numerical profile,
and failure rules as the corresponding signal realization. \\
\Req{018} & An NOI-informed update shall create an immutable successor;
per-member relearning is a different, unavailable-in-v0.1 method. \\
\Req{019} & The method shall have no automatic selector or fallback. A
requested unavailable route fails closed without silent substitution. \\
\Req{020} & When matching parent-covariance authority exists, a produced field
shall carry $C_{\rm realized}=\widetilde LC_{\rm parent}\widetilde L^{\mathsf T}$;
$C_{\rm reference}=LC_{\rm parent}L^{\mathsf T}$ remains a separate comparator. \\
\Req{021} & $d_p^{-1}$ shall be called marginal conditional variance only
under every constrained local GLS premise; otherwise $d_p$ is normalization. \\
\Req{022} & Uncertainty availability and U1--U7 shall be truthful and
role-separated; missing covariance, cross-covariance, or entries are
unavailable rather than zero or independent. \\
\Req{023} & The public signal product shall be the role-complete atomic bundle
defined in Section~\ref{sec:product-roles}. \\
\Req{024} & Failure of any required signal member shall prevent a complete
publication candidate; a partial bundle shall not be published as complete. \\
\Req{025} & Covariance, frozen-NOI uncertainty, response, and state/lineage
companions shall be independently atomic and qualified by exact identity,
population, unit, support, validity, lifecycle, and named-use policy. \\
\Req{026} & The lifecycle states in Section~\ref{sec:lifecycle} shall remain
distinct; in particular \NotRequested{} is not \Disabled{}, and a complete
publication candidate is not publication, validation, or readiness. \\
\Req{027} & No numerator, denominator, kernel, field-power estimate, response
slice, inverse scale, standardized field, or intermediate is public without a
complete science-product role and policy. \\
\Req{028} & The product contract shall preserve a first-class FLT-to-FRUIT
producer envelope identifying filtered quantity, template, response, valid
support, units/calibration, method/state, uncertainty availability, and
provenance without undocumented implementation state. \\
\Req{029} & No FLT artifact or profile shall define FRUIT source modeling,
subtraction/add-back, recurrence, learning, stopping, restart, selection,
response, uncertainty, or interpretation. \\
\Req{030} & The method performs fixed-template, fixed-anchor, one-parameter
linear amplitude estimation. Candidate selection, position/morphology/
background fitting, deblending, existence inference, catalogs, significance,
completeness, purity, and SRC ownership remain outside scope. \\
\Req{031} & Posterior/Wiener sky reconstruction, ordinary convolution,
data-thresholded destriping, adaptive edge/background methods, and the
historical high-pass/delta case remain separate methods. \texttt{SCI-FLT-FIXED}
remains a separate protected package. \\
\Req{032} & Every affected AO route shall receive its exact required owner or
engineering disposition before dependent scientific use is available. An
AO selection cannot manufacture an unavailable parent, template, or authority. \\
\Req{033} & The scientific method is the exact selected $n_p/d_p$ operator.
Ordinary finite precision is evaluated under one preregistered engineering
numerical-conformance profile. A scientifically different operator receives a
separate method/realization identity and retains its discrepancy. \\
\Req{034} & Scientific authority, implementation conformity, representation
fidelity, observational validation, achieved performance, readiness, and
production shall be separate claims with separate evidence and owners. \\
\Req{035} & SCI-VAL shall evaluate an owner-approved named-use profile on
separate request, applicability, eligibility, and realization axes. It shall
not perform filtering, publication, or observational/scientific validation. \\
\Req{036} & Parent and template calibration dependence shall remain joint.
Point-source flux, matched-filter beam/solid angle, extended-source fidelity,
and calibration covariance require exact separate authority. \\
\Req{037} & A coadd application shall retain exact contributing-observation
membership and parent provenance without asserting filter/coadd commutation. \\
\Req{038} & Every product shall bind exact MAP, template, NOI, and FLT-to-FRUIT
boundary records, the full realization tuple, immutable provenance, supported
query/reconstruction contract, and a route-status record. \\
\Req{039} & This Stage B draft and every unselected option shall make no
implementation, conformity, covariance/response fidelity, observational
validation, performance, readiness, production, scientific-freeze, or Unity
claim. \\
\Req{040} & Base v0.1 shall evaluate one anchor at each exact parent pixel
center and preserve parent WCS/frame/grid/shape/index/order/pixel-center
conventions. No interpolation is admitted; other lattices are successors. \\
\Req{041} & Local covariance shall be $C_p=E_pC_{\rm parent}E_p^{\mathsf T}$
and local GLS shall invert only its exact estimable restriction. A global-
precision subblock is a separate conditional method. \\
\Req{042} & $\Supp_{\rm apply}$, $\Supp_{\rm template}$, $\Supp_{\rm state}$,
$\Supp_{\rm response}$, and $\Supp_{\rm store}$ shall be separately recorded;
exact-zero application coefficients do not dereference parent payload. \\
\Req{043} & The general-sky expectation shall retain all off-diagonal template
response and $L_{p,g}b$ nuisance leakage. Unit diagonal response shall not imply
source attribution, isolation, or absence of bias. \\
\Req{044} & When state is parent-learned, full-procedure response requires an
authorized Learn--Resolve rerun or predeclared finite difference and a separate
state-change record; otherwise it is unavailable. \\
\Req{045} & Any amplitude field generated with $\widetilde L$ shall carry
$R_{\rm realized}=\widetilde LT$ and any authorized $C_{\rm realized}$, not
reference quantities mislabeled as actual. \\
\Req{046} & Covariance scientific scope shall be selected independently as
complete, named projected, or unavailable; exact representation shall be
selected independently and shall not change covariance identity. \\
\Req{047} & Exact immutable state and its required query vocabulary shall be
reproducible across full, compact, or lineage representation without changing
the estimator or signal generation. \\
\Req{048} & Response domain, query vocabulary, validity, and consumer scope
shall be defined before choosing materialized, structured, or lineage
representation; FLT shall not guess future FRUIT requirements. \\
\Req{049} & PA, SA, SP, CU, NU, RU, and FH verdict meanings and their dependency
graph are normative. Profile count/layer/vector layout is lossless
representation only; a scalar verdict shall not drive scientific action. \\
\Req{050} & Covariance zero-variance modes, excluded or infinite-variance
modes, weighting-null modes, and template-unidentifiable modes shall remain
distinct exact subspace classifications. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

\section{Falsifiable scientific predictions}
\label{sec:predictions}

Each prediction is conditional on the cited assumptions and is falsified by a
conforming counterexample in its declared domain. Failure authorizes no
fallback.

\begin{longtable}{p{0.25\linewidth}p{0.52\linewidth}p{0.13\linewidth}}
\toprule
Prediction & Falsifiable statement & Assumptions \\
\midrule
\endhead
\Pred{001} & An exact unit-amplitude matching template at admitted $p$ gives
$R_{\rm fixed}(p,p)=1$. & 003--006 \\
\Pred{002} & At fixed state, a noiseless matching template scaled by $A$ gives
exactly $\widehat a_p=A$. & 003--006 \\
\Pred{003} & With zero conditional-mean noise and a matching template,
$\operatorname E[\widehat a_p\mid g]=A$. & 003--007 \\
\Pred{004} & An anchor missing any nonzero application-support dependency is
never published as a numerical amplitude. & 004,006 \\
\Pred{005} & Nonfinite, nonreal, zero, or negative $d_p$ never produces zero
amplitude as a substitute. & 005--006 \\
\Pred{006} & Observation and coadd applications retain distinct parent and
state identities. & 001,010 \\
\Pred{007} & Every compatible NOI member has the identical fixed $L$, support,
normalization, profile, and failure decisions as its signal realization. & 010--011 \\
\Pred{008} & For draws from the exact declared parent stochastic law with
conditional covariance $C_{\rm parent}$, empirical covariance of fixed-state
transformed fields converges to $LC_{\rm parent}L^{\mathsf T}$ under the
declared sampling theorem and uncertainty. An NOI ensemble supports this only
when separate authority establishes the same target covariance. & 008--011 \\
\Pred{009} & Without exact constrained local GLS premises, removing a
$d_p^{-1}$ variance label changes no amplitude value and removes the
unsupported uncertainty claim. & 005,008--009 \\
\Pred{010} & A realized operator accepted under its preregistered engineering
profile satisfies every predeclared numerical rule; this is conformance to the
profile, not a scientific error budget or performance claim. & 012--013 \\
\Pred{011} & A consequential realization-field change creates a new identity
and never mutates an existing product. & 010, 013, 015 \\
\Pred{012} & Failure of one required signal member prevents a complete
publication candidate. & 015 \\
\Pred{013} & Failure of an optional companion leaves a complete signal bundle
unchanged unless its named-use policy requires that companion. & 009, 013, 015 \\
\Pred{014} & Rescaling $t\mapsto ct$ gives
$\widehat a\mapsto\widehat a/c$ while preserving $\widehat a t$. & 003,014 \\
\Pred{015} & A one-kernel response representation fails where its required
invariances do not hold. & 002,013 \\
\Pred{016} & Requesting an unavailable route never silently selects another
route. & 015 \\
\Pred{017} & A signal bundle plus its declared response/state interface answers
every supported FLT-side handoff query without undocumented state. & 013,015 \\
\Pred{018} & No conforming output alone is a detection, catalog entry,
posterior sky, FRUIT result, performance claim, readiness decision, or
production decision. & 001--015 \\
\Pred{019} & With two nonzero template amplitudes, the expectation at $p$
equals $R(p,s_1)A_{s_1}+R(p,s_2)A_{s_2}$ plus any nuisance term. & 003--009 \\
\Pred{020} & A nonzero constant or gradient background changes
$\operatorname E[\widehat a_p]$ by exactly $L_{p,g}b$ when that contraction is
nonzero. & 003--009 \\
\Pred{021} & A nonzero off-diagonal $R_{\rm fixed}(p,s)$ produces a response at
$p$ to a unit template at $s\ne p$ despite exact unit diagonal response. & 003--009 \\
\Pred{022} & A mismatched signal shape returns its response-weighted template
amplitude and need not equal any unconstrained source property. & 003--009 \\
\Pred{023} & For parent-learned state, an authorized full-procedure response
can differ from fixed-state response exactly through the recorded state change;
without rerun authority the former remains unavailable. & 010 \\
\Pred{024} & If $\widetilde L\ne L$, empirical covariance of draws transformed
by $\widetilde L$ converges to $C_{\rm realized}$, not to
$C_{\rm reference}$, under the declared sampling theorem. & 008--012 \\

\section{Unselected authored option sets}
\label{sec:authored-options}

All alternatives below remain unselected. Every scientific weight is exact,
self-adjoint, positive semidefinite, and used through exact normalization.
Observation and coadd dispositions and generations remain separate.

\subsection{\AO{001}: Weighting and noise authority}

Each route binds the map chart, units, support, population, Learn/Resolve
identity, exact subspaces, window/boundary action, regularization, coefficient
roles, diagnostics, state uncertainty, generations, and failure disposition.

\subsubsection{\AOpt{001}{A}: exact constrained local inverse-covariance GLS}
\begin{description}
\item[Science.] Restrict exact authorized $C_{\rm parent}$ with $E_p$, then use
$W_p=U_pC_{p,E}^{-1}U_p^{\mathsf T}$ on the declared estimable subspace with
identifiable projected template. This alone supports the theorem in
Section~\ref{sec:optimality}.
\item[Failure and evidence.] Missing covariance authority, population or
conditioning mismatch, nonpositive $C_{p,E}$, subspace mismatch, or
unidentifiable template makes GLS/optimality unavailable. Future assessment
checks the exact theorem and the preregistered numerical profile separately.
\end{description}

\subsubsection{\AOpt{001}{B}: structured covariance-derived weighting}
\begin{description}
\item[Science.] Resolve one exact self-adjoint PSD structured weight derived
from a declared covariance family. The selected $W_p$ is exact science even
when it is not the exact covariance inverse. Normalization and unit response
remain; optimality and $d_p^{-1}$ variance do not.
\item[Failure and evidence.] Unbound structure, population, modes, support,
regularization, or covariance ancestry fails the route. Any comparison with an
inverse covariance is an engineering/profile observable, not an implied claim.
\end{description}

\subsubsection{\AOpt{001}{C}: radially symmetrized field-power spectral weighting}
\begin{description}
\item[Object.] Resolve a declared field population $f_j$ and transform
\[
 F_j(k)=\alpha\sum_q H(q)f_j(q)e^{-2\pi i k\cdot r_q}\mu_q,
 \qquad
 \overline P_b=\frac{\sum_{j,k\in B_b}w_{jk}|F_j(k)|^2}
                         {\sum_{j,k\in B_b}w_{jk}}.
\]
The source may be an independently authorized noise population or a declared
parent-derived field. Its name and deterministic-residual imprint are retained.
\item[Exact conventions.] Each radial bin is half-open
$B_b=[\rho_b,\rho_{b+1})$ except the declared final-boundary rule; boundary ties
use one deterministic assignment. Member/mode weights are finite and
nonnegative and their denominator is positive. Phase, normalization, units,
conjugate modes, multiplicities, averaging order, WCS metric, window, and
support are exact.
\item[Weight and modes.] On admitted modes
$w_{\rm spec}(k)=(\overline P_{b(k)}+\lambda_b)^{-1}$ with
$\lambda_b\geq0$ in the units of $\overline P_b$. Regularized modes and
excluded-null modes are distinct. A sparse bin is never interpolated or
borrowed from neighbors without a separately authored rule.
\item[Consequences.] Radialization deliberately loses angular information and
implies no noise, covariance, stationarity, isotropy, or optimality claim.
$d_p$ is normalization. Matching covariance, if any, requires independent
authority.
\item[Failure and evidence.] Invalid weights/denominator, nonfinite or negative
power, unbound ties/multiplicity, missing field provenance, incomplete support,
or hidden borrowing fails the route. Future evidence reports bin membership,
source imprint, anisotropy/dispersion, leakage, regularization, response, and
NOI parity without promoting them to scientific thresholds.
\end{description}

\subsubsection{\AOpt{001}{D}: declared weaker positive-semidefinite weighting}
\begin{description}
\item[Science.] Resolve any other exact self-adjoint PSD map or transform-domain
weight with declared purpose, population, units, support, rank/null,
regularization, and lineage, but no covariance ancestry claim.
\item[Failure and evidence.] Non-self-adjointness, indefiniteness, hidden
coefficients, state drift, incomplete support, or invalid $d_p$ fails the
route. No optimality or variance meaning follows.
\end{description}

\subsection{\AO{002}: Operator realization and numerical-conformance class}

No numerical constant in this family is scientific authority. Exactly one
engineering profile is preregistered per realized numerical identity.

\subsubsection{\AOpt{002}{A}: numerical realization of the exact operator}
The scientific operator, response, support, subspaces, and failure semantics
are exact. The preregistered engineering profile binds floating-point format,
algorithms, environment, exact comparator, domains, norms, scales, projectors,
coverage, and acceptance rules before results are seen. Profile pass is only a
numerical-conformance statement.

\subsubsection{\AOpt{002}{B}: intentionally distinct scientific operator}
This route is admissible only through separate owner authority that states the
affected quantity, estimand, response/support/null discrepancy, scientific
error budget, norm/domain, calibration consequence, consumers, and rationale.
It creates a distinct method or realization identity; it is not ordinary
finite precision and cannot borrow the exact operator's response/covariance.

\subsubsection{\AOpt{002}{C}: numerical route unavailable}
If no preregistered profile, exact comparator, domain/coverage, or required
projector exists, no numerical-conformance claim is available. No threshold,
iteration count, percentile, or post-hoc test supplies a fallback.

\subsection{\AO{003}: Conditional-covariance scope and representation}

This family requires one scientific-scope disposition from A--C and, for an
available scope, one exact-representation disposition from D--E. Equivalent
exact representations retain one covariance identity.

\subsubsection{\AOpt{003}{A}: complete scientific covariance scope}
Every authorized entry and correlation of the actual produced field is in
scope on the full valid output domain, with exact population, conditioning,
units, rank/null, calibration terms, response, and generation.

\subsubsection{\AOpt{003}{B}: named projected scientific covariance scope}
Only $P_cC_{\rm realized}P_c^{\mathsf T}$ for a named consumer projection is in
scope. The projection basis, measure, rank, validity, and consumer are exact;
all outside correlations remain unknown.

\subsubsection{\AOpt{003}{C}: covariance unavailable}
Missing parent-covariance or cross-term authority is typed unavailability. The
signal may remain complete, but no variance, standardization, significance,
draw, independence, or covariance-dependent use follows.

\subsubsection{\AOpt{003}{D}: exact resident covariance representation}
Represent the selected scope by an explicit array or exact structured object.
The representation type and query vocabulary are declared; every supported
entry/quadratic form is exact, and no representation-only change alters the
scientific covariance identity.

\subsubsection{\AOpt{003}{E}: exact lineage/on-demand covariance representation}
Persist exact immutable lineage sufficient to reconstruct every supported
query without undocumented state. Each result is immutable and carries the
same covariance identity. Missing lineage or unsupported queries are
unavailable, never zero.

\subsection{\AO{004}: Immutable-state representation}

The scientific invariant for every alternative is exact reproducibility of the
resolved immutable state and its required query vocabulary. Representation
alone does not change the estimator or signal generation.

\subsubsection{\AOpt{004}{A}: full materialization}
Persist every resolved state element with exact indexing, units, population,
generation, and canonical identity. Reload shall reproduce every supported
operator/state query exactly under the numerical profile.

\subsubsection{\AOpt{004}{B}: compact exact state}
Persist an exact factorization or sufficient-state representation plus complete
query semantics. Discarded information is allowed only when proved irrelevant
to every supported query. Unsupported queries are unavailable.

\subsubsection{\AOpt{004}{C}: exact lineage reconstruction}
Persist immutable inputs, Learn/Resolve algorithms and versions, environment
facts, and identity needed for deterministic reconstruction. Missing or mutable
lineage fails dependent routes; relearning is not a fallback.

\subsection{\AO{005}: Response science and exact representation}

Before representation, every route binds fixed/FP/realized/reference type,
anchor domains, index/measure, query vocabulary, validity, units/calibration,
state/operator/template generation, consumer scope, retention, and failure.
FLT does not guess a future FRUIT query.

\subsubsection{\AOpt{005}{A}: full response materialization}
Materialize every response entry in the authorized domain with exact index
maps and identity. A matrix does not by itself authorize a beam, moment,
integral, or other reduced interpretation.

\subsubsection{\AOpt{005}{B}: exact structured response}
Persist an exact factorization or mathematical object that answers the entire
declared query vocabulary without unproved invariance. Unsupported queries are
typed unavailable.

\subsubsection{\AOpt{005}{C}: exact lineage/on-demand response}
Persist complete immutable lineage needed to reconstruct supported response
queries without undocumented state. Query results are immutable; failure does
not substitute a reduced kernel.

\subsection{\AO{006}: Role-separated SCI-VAL verdict representation}

The normative policy is one dependency graph over seven separate verdicts:
PA, SA, SP, CU, NU, RU, and FH. Each retains request, applicability,
eligibility, realization, producer facts, policy, action, lifecycle, evidence,
and version. The alternatives are lossless representations of the same policy.

\subsubsection{\AOpt{006}{A}: seven separate records}
Persist one immutable record per role. A view may list all verdicts but has no
actionable scalar aggregate.

\subsubsection{\AOpt{006}{B}: grouped layered records}
Group roles into declared layers only while retaining seven independently
addressable subverdicts and the full dependency graph. A layer summary cannot
replace the subverdict vector.

\subsubsection{\AOpt{006}{C}: one seven-role verdict vector}
Persist one composite with seven separately addressable complete records.
Consumers request a named component. A scalar may be human-readable only and
shall never drive action.

\subsection{Option closure}

Until exact dispositions exist, affected weighting, numerical-conformance,
covariance, state-query, response-query, SCI-VAL, and handoff routes remain
unavailable. Selection establishes no implementation conformity, response or
covariance fidelity, observational validation, performance, readiness,
production, freeze, or Unity status.
